title: A playback id in every log line, from the play request to each segment
description: Debugging real-device and failover findings needs to follow one playback through api, stream and worker logs. The first slice of JS-021 and JS-022, moved up.
acceptanceCriteria: PlaybackInfo, the stream requests, the job and the worker's ffmpeg log lines of one playback carry the same id
docs/running.md shows how to follow one playback
notes: JS-153's decision line already carries the play session id (D-038).
